displayName: CIAM002 - External users: block sign-up and sign-in from anonymized IPs
notes: Targets the Identity Protection network location category 'Anonymized IP address' (Tor exit nodes and known VPN-for-abuse ranges). Deployed in report-only first and promoted to enforced only after confirming it does not block a meaningful share of legitimate privacy-conscious customers; the false-positive tradeoff is real and worth measuring before enforcing.
